title: Japanese-Style Braised White Beans
description: A hearty, comforting dish of slow-cooked white beans in a rich, savory sauce inspired by Japanese cuisine.

ingredients.name: Dried Japanese-style dashi (or substitute)
ingredients.notes: available at most Asian grocery stores

instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add sliced ginger and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add soy sauce and braising liquid (dashi or substitute), stirring to combine.
Add white beans and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until beans are tender.
Stir in chopped green onions and sesame seeds.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
